title: Energy Dispersive X-ray Fluorescence Analyzer JEOL｜Easy-to-operate X-ray fluorescence analyzer with qualitative and quantitative analysis and screening function for RoHS elements

Energy Dispersive X-ray Fluorescence Analyzer JEOL｜Easy-to-operate X-ray fluorescence analyzer with qualitative and quantitative analysis and screening function for RoHS elements
Product Information
Easy-to-operate X-ray fluorescence analyzer with qualitative and quantitative analysis and screening function for RoHS elements
Energy Dispersive X-ray Fluorescence Analyzer JEOL
Easy-to-operate X-ray fluorescence analyzer with qualitative and quantitative analysis and screening function for RoHS elements
 JSX-1000S is a fluorescent X-ray spectrometer that uses a touch panel for easy elemental analysis. Equipped with general qualitative and analysis (FP method, cabibration curve method) and RoHS element screening function. various options for both hardware and software enable a wider range of analyses. 
■Main specifications of JSX-1000S 
detection element range：Mg～U / F～U（optional） 
Ｘ-ray generator：5～50　kV , 1mA 
target：Rh 
primary filter up to 9 types automatic replacement：OPEN, ND, Cr, Pb, Cd　(standard） 
　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　 Cl, Cu, Mo, Sb　(optional） 
collimator 3 types automatic exchange：0.9mm, 2mm, 9mm 
detector：silicon drift detector 
sample chamber size：300mmφ×80mmH 
sample chamber atmosphere：atmosphere / vacuum(optional） 
sample chamber observation mechanism：color camera 
operating computer：Windows® touch panel desktop computer 
analysis software：qualitative analysis（automatic qualitative,KLM markersum, peak display, spectrum search） 
qualitative analysis（bulk FP method、calibration curve method） 
RoHS analysis solution（Cd,Pb,Hg,Br,Cr) 
simple analysis solution 
reporting software 
daily check software：tube aging, energy check, strength check
